welcome.title: Welcome
about.paragraph1: On the slopes of Mount Kozjak, in Kaštela, a small agricultural town between Split and Trogir, high-quality and premium wines are produced.
about.paragraph2: The Kuzmanić family has been producing white and red wines in the traditional way for several generations. Their vineyard lies near the Biblical Garden – the ancient shrine of Our Lady of Stomorija in Kaštel Novi – with a breathtaking view of the Bay of Kaštela.
about.paragraph3: The entire process, from cultivating and maintaining the vineyard to harvesting and crushing the grapes, is done by hand, with every member of the family involved. After a year of dedicated work, they produce four wines, all from varieties indigenous to central Dalmatia.
wine.intro: Red and white wines made the traditional way, from grapes grown in our own vineyard.
wine.alt: A bottle of {name} with a glass
stay.title: Wine, stay and the sea
about.last.section.paragraph1: This small boutique winery is part of the family home, which also offers accommodation, and is close to the beach and Split Airport.
about.last.section.paragraph2: The vineyard and winery are ideal for hosting small groups for tastings of their multiple award-winning wines. The selection includes the red wines Crljenak kaštelanski, Plavac mali and Babica, and the white wine Trbljan.

tour.start: Wine tour in the Biblical Garden of Our Lady of Stomorija
tour.subtitle: A tasting, a walk to the vineyard and the story of the Kaštela winegrowing and winemaking tradition.
tour.program.title: What to expect
tour.para1: Guests arrive at the Biblical Garden and are introduced to the symbolism of the garden and the shrine of Our Lady of Stomorija. We taste four wines: two reds (Crljenak and Babica) and two whites (Pošip and Trbljan bijeli). Babica and Trbljan bijeli are indigenous Kaštela varieties. The tasting is accompanied by local delicacies: prosciutto, cheese, salted anchovies, tuna pâté and bread, followed by candied orange peel (arancini) and sugared almonds.
tour.para2: Glass in hand, we stroll to the Kuzmanić vineyard, where guests learn about the traditional way of tending the vines and the indigenous Kaštela varieties that grow there.
tour.para3: Back in the Biblical Garden, guests can buy any of the Kuzmanić wines presented on the tour.
tour.label: Tour information
tour.details2: The winery owner and heritage interpreter, in traditional costume
tour.end: We hope our guests leave enriched by new experiences, taking with them a piece of the unique Kaštela tradition of winegrowing and winemaking.
